points.en: Uluru might just be the most photographed rock in the world. This beautiful, enormous rock is located in Uluru National Park, 450 kilometres from Alice Springs in Australia.
points.uz: Uluru dunyodagi eng ko'p suratga olingan tosh bo'lsa kerak. Bu go'zal, ulkan tosh Avstraliyada, Alis-Springsdan 450 kilometr uzoqlikdagi Uluru milliy bog'ida joylashgan.

points.en: The rock was first seen by Europeans in 1872 and was discovered by Ernest Giles. It was called Ayers Rock until 1985 when it was given back to the Anangu Aborigines. They are deeply religious people and the giant rock is very special to them. That's why it's now called Uluru, which means 'The Centre of the Earth'.
points.uz: Toshni yevropaliklar birinchi marta 1872-yilda ko'rgan va u Ernest Jayls tomonidan kashf etilgan. U 1985-yilgacha Ayers Rock deb atalgan, o'sha yili u Anangu aborigenlariga qaytarib berilgan. Ular chuqur dindor odamlar va ulkan tosh ular uchun juda alohida. Shuning uchun u endi 'Yerning markazi' degan ma'noni anglatuvchi Uluru deb ataladi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ PARA 2 - Historical Facts.
⚠ Past majhul: was discovered, was called, was given back.

points.en: Uluru is surrounded by very flat land, so the giant rock can be seen from far away. People are always amazed by its beautiful orange colour and they enjoy exploring its small caves that contain fascinating carvings and drawings. Visitors who climb to the top of Uluru also get a fantastic view of the countryside.
points.uz: Uluru juda tekis yer bilan o'ralgan, shuning uchun ulkan toshni uzoqdan ko'rish mumkin. Odamlar uning go'zal to'q sariq rangidan doim hayratda qolishadi va qiziqarli o'yma va chizmalar bo'lgan kichik g'orlarini kezishdan zavqlanishadi. Uluru tepasiga chiqqan tashrif buyuruvchilar atrofning ajoyib manzarasidan ham bahramand bo'lishadi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ PARA 3 - Things to see/do there.
⚠ 'is surrounded by', 'are always amazed by', 'can be seen'.

points.en: Uluru is certainly one of nature's most dramatic and beautiful sights. It should not be missed by any visitors to the Australian Outback.
points.uz: Uluru, shubhasiz, tabiatning eng ta'sirchan va go'zal manzaralaridan biri. Avstraliya cho'liga tashrif buyuruvchilar uni o'tkazib yubormasligi kerak.
points.noteUz:
⚠ PARA 4 - Recommendation.
⚠ 'should not be missed' - modal majhul.

structure.modelEn: The Pyramid of the Sun might just be the most impressive pyramid in the Americas. This enormous pyramid is located in the ancient city of Teotihuacan in Mexico. It has hundreds of steps that lead up to the site of an old temple.
structure.modelUz: Quyosh piramidasi Amerikadagi eng ta'sirchan piramida bo'lsa kerak. Bu ulkan piramida Meksikadagi qadimiy Teotiuakan shahrida joylashgan. Unda eski ibodatxona joyiga olib chiqadigan yuzlab zinalar bor.

structure.modelEn: The pyramid was built by the Teotihuacanos and was completed in AD 200. It is made of earth and red rock and it was used for religious reasons. The ancient city was first found by the Aztecs many centuries later.
structure.modelUz: Piramida teotiuakanliklar tomonidan qurilgan va milodiy 200-yilda tugatilgan. U tuproq va qizil toshdan qurilgan va diniy maqsadlarda ishlatilgan. Qadimiy shaharni ko'p asrlar keyin atsteklar birinchi topgan.

structure.modelEn: Visitors can climb up the steps to the top of the pyramid and admire the wonderful view. From the top, two other pyramids and an ancient road can be seen.
structure.modelUz: Tashrif buyuruvchilar zinalardan piramida tepasiga chiqib, ajoyib manzaradan bahra olishlari mumkin. Tepadan yana ikkita piramida va qadimiy yo'lni ko'rish mumkin.

structure.modelEn: The Pyramid of the Sun is certainly one of the most fascinating sights in Mexico. It should not be missed by any visitors to the country.
structure.modelUz: Quyosh piramidasi, shubhasiz, Meksikadagi eng qiziqarli manzaralardan biri. Mamlakatga tashrif buyuruvchilar uni o'tkazib yubormasligi kerak.

modelAnswers:
The Pyramid of the Sun

The Pyramid of the Sun might just be the most impressive pyramid in the Americas. This enormous pyramid is located in the ancient city of Teotihuacan in Mexico. It has hundreds of steps that lead up to the site of an old temple.

The pyramid was built by the Teotihuacanos and was completed in AD 200. It is made of earth and red rock and it was used for religious reasons. The ancient city was first found by the Aztecs many centuries later.

Visitors can climb up the steps to the top of the pyramid and admire the wonderful view. From the top, two other pyramids and an ancient road can be seen.

The Pyramid of the Sun is certainly one of the most fascinating sights in Mexico. It should not be missed by any visitors to the country.
modelAnswersUz:
Quyosh piramidasi

Quyosh piramidasi Amerikadagi eng ta'sirchan piramida bo'lsa kerak. Bu ulkan piramida Meksikadagi qadimiy Teotiuakan shahrida joylashgan. Unda eski ibodatxona joyiga olib chiqadigan yuzlab zinalar bor.

Piramida teotiuakanliklar tomonidan qurilgan va milodiy 200-yilda tugatilgan. U tuproq va qizil toshdan qurilgan va diniy maqsadlarda ishlatilgan. Qadimiy shaharni ko'p asrlar keyin atsteklar birinchi topgan.

Tashrif buyuruvchilar zinalardan piramida tepasiga chiqib, ajoyib manzaradan bahra olishlari mumkin. Tepadan yana ikkita piramida va qadimiy yo'lni ko'rish mumkin.

Quyosh piramidasi, shubhasiz, Meksikadagi eng qiziqarli manzaralardan biri. Mamlakatga tashrif buyuruvchilar uni o'tkazib yubormasligi kerak.
